Our Programs

Our programs combine practical community action with education, health, environment, and empowerment. Each program is presented in English and Hindi so visitors can understand the work clearly.

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about donations, volunteering, internships, projects, and applications.

You can donate by opening the donation section and scanning the displayed QR code with a supported UPI or banking app. Please keep your payment confirmation for your records.

Donation receipt availability depends on the foundation's current payment and accounting process. Please contact the foundation if you need a receipt or confirmation for a specific contribution.

Yes. Volunteers can contribute in areas such as teaching, social media, graphic design, fundraising, field work, and event support. Your role can be matched to your skills and availability.

Open the Student Internship section, complete the registration form, upload the required documents and signatures, accept the declaration, and submit the application. The Admin Panel reviews the application before approval.

The Premium Internship Offer Letter becomes available after your internship application is reviewed and approved by the foundation through the Admin Panel.

Use the Student Project Submission form inside the internship section. Enter your internship details, project title, description, and project link or file, then submit it for Admin Panel review.

Complete the relevant application form on the website with your contact details and area of interest. The foundation team can review the submission and follow up when required.

Founder / President

Leadership of Nisha Seva Foundation

Founder / President

Sachin Meena

A graduate from Village Kelanwas, Sachin Meena has completed an M.A. in Political Science. Alongside his interest in digital media as a YouTuber with the Sang Official Channel, he is an entrepreneur associated with Isha Enterprises and works in real estate. He brings together business experience, communication, and community-minded leadership.

EntrepreneurDigital MediaReal Estate
General Secretary

Sunder Meena

Sunder Meena is a graduate who works with the NGO sector. As General Secretary of Nisha Seva Foundation, he contributes to the organization’s activities and supports its efforts to serve the community.

NGO WorkCommunity Service
